top_signals.title: Gold Rebounds as Investors Seek Cash
top_signals.summary: Gold is trying to recover after its worst October since 2008, but market jitters are turning the metal into a source of liquidity, not a safe haven.  Suki Cooper,  Standard Chartered Global Head of Commodities Research explains the pressure near $4,000, where support may emerge, and why silver faces even tougher headwinds. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet crypto thefts on outdated instances
top_signals.summary: The maintainer of BTCPay Server, an open-source cryptocurrency payment processor, has urged users to install the latest version as hackers have been draining "hot wallets" on instances running older versions. [...]
